Beautiful walk through larch trees until Pian du Scricc then climb up to Pian Sass Mor, a steep rampart precedes the Valtendra Pass, a long traverse up to the Scatta d'Orogna, the flat Val Buscagna and a last steep descent leads to the Devero

r.name: F97 - Bivio F10 - Passo delle Possette
r.description: Up to Valle Traccia EE, then dirt track and beautiful trail

r.name: H99 - Alpe Devero - Passo di Valtendra
r.description: The initial stretch to go up to Val Buscagna is tiring, then it is a long, almost flat walk with a short steep stretch for the Scatta d'Orogna, steep descent to the lake and to Val Bondolero then ascent to Valtendra

r.name: F99 - Alpe Veglia - Passo di Valtendra
r.description: Beautiful walk in the larch woods up to Pian du Scricc then go up to Pian Sass Mor where appear the steep rampart that precedes the Valtendra Pass, years ago covered by perennial snowfield and now land without vegetation

r.name: F28 - Alpe Veglia - Bocchetta di Aurona
r.description: Very dangerous path for falling rocks in the final part, where the glacier of Aurona disappeared, equipped with chains and pegs fixed in the rock. Path clearly visible except at the beginning of the dangerous part due to landslides.
Sentiero Italia - Tappa E59

r.name: F50b - Ciamporino - Alpe Solcio
r.description: Superb panoramic half mountainside route, along the path of Alta Via Val Divedro, along pastures still loaded for grazing of cattle with refurbished huts for holiday use where the original features have been maintained.

r.name: F50 - Alpe Veglia - Ciamporino
r.description: From the Rifugio CAI Città di Arona a path in a larch wood leads first to the Alpe La Balma and then to the "Portea". From here, up to Ciamporino, you will walk on a long natural balcony with an enchanting view of the surrounding peaks.
after 120 m of ascent on the rail, continue on dirt until the end

r.name: F22 - Alpe Veglia - Lago Bianco - Passo di Boccareccio
r.description: steep and difficult path, up to Lago Bianco, 2160 m; quiet from the lake to Pian d'Erbioi 2300 m. then last stretch very steep, tiring, on an impervious path

r.name: Via dell' Arbola Tappa 2 - Dal Devero a Binn (tratto svizzero)
H07 - Goglio - Colle di Ciamporino
r.description: The path up to Cima Piaggio is very steep, then a long and shady dirt road and another steep stretch to reach the vast meadows of Alpe Bondolero and then the slopes of San Domenico ski.

r.name: F16 - San Domenico - Monte Cistella
r.description: Long but rewarding climb. From the summit of Monte Cistella the view is spectacular at 360 °. Suitable for normal hikers except for a short final stretch under the summit which requires a short climb, there is a chain (2022).
Half-way path, little frequented, but pleasant. Steep salt to reach the flower path or F50 to Alpe Veglia

r.name: H13 - Alpe Buscagna - Passo di Cornera
H11 - Alpe Devero - Monte Cazzola
r.description: The route begins in a larch forest to Alpe Misanco; beyond this point, the vegetation thins out and eventually disappears, and the path continues through an almost lunar landscape to the Buscagna Lakes and, finally, to our destination.
